title: Keep-in-Touch Rotation Gaps
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=keptintouch:contact person=*
| stats latest(_time) as last_contact, values(channel) as channels by person
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_contact)/86400,0)
| where days_since>45
| sort - days_since
description: Lists loved ones who have quietly fallen out of your contact rotation.
value: The people who matter most are often the easiest to delay contacting because there is no hard deadline.
implementation: Collect contact reminders and completions in `index=personal`; alert when the contact gap exceeds your threshold.
visualization: Table of people with days since last contact and last-used channel.
grandmaExplanation: It warns which people you have not checked in on for too long, so important relationships do not drift by accident.
